cohort: All deliveries recorded in the Finnish Medical Birth Registry (1,481,160 births) and the Estonian Medical Birth Registry (356,063 births) between 1992 and 2016.
finding: Operative delivery rates in Estonia and Finland reached one in four by 2016, with significant differences in specific trends and incidences of Caesarean sections and operative vaginal deliveries between the two countries.
mod_finding: By 2016, Estonia's CS rate tripled to 20.9% and OVD rate increased nine-fold to 5.6%, whereas Finland's CS rate slightly increased to 16.4% and OVD rate nearly doubled to 9.4%; epidural/spinal anaesthesia and foetal birthweight increased OVD risk, while maternal age increased CS risk in both countries.
